description: Threads Operator Hermes runtime jobs. Installed/updated/removed by scripts/install_jobs.sh. Schedules and delivery targets mirror the verified live jobs (captured 2026-09-23).

jobs.name: Threads Insights Collector
jobs.purpose: Collect per-post + account insights snapshots into Supabase every 5 minutes. Silent on success; Telegram alert after 3 failed attempts.

jobs.name: Threads Activity Follow Collector
jobs.purpose: Read-only browser collector: detect new followers/follow-backs from Threads Activity, write follow events to Supabase.

jobs.name: Threads Stale-Claim Watchdog
jobs.purpose: Recover publish-queue rows stuck in a claimed/processing state (worker crash or timeout) so they are retried instead of wedged.

jobs.name: Threads Trend Engagement Watchdog ({{ACCOUNT}})
jobs.purpose: Every 30m: check execute-approved trend replies for publishing success; draft replies for newly approved trend candidates and send Telegram approval cards.

jobs.name: Threads Own-Replies Watchdog ({{ACCOUNT}})
jobs.purpose: Every 5m: publish execute-approved own-post replies; poll new inbound replies on own posts; draft replies for approval-pending ones and send Telegram approval cards; Task 2C: draft DM opportunities and send Telegram approval cards (no DM is sent).

jobs.name: Threads Trend Approval Timeout Watchdog ({{ACCOUNT}})
jobs.purpose: Hourly: reject own/trend candidates pending too long without a decision; send the operator a timeout summary.

jobs.name: Threads Trend Discovery ({{ACCOUNT}})
jobs.purpose: Agent-based: search public Threads for strong Malaysian-audience trend candidates, ingest via CLI (trend add --external), read-only enrich, alert only on new inserts.
